staff.name: Ryan Coleman
staff.bio:
Ryan Coleman grew up immersed in the world of theatre, but it wasn’t until he began taking acting classes at Second City that he rediscovered his passion for comedy and the performing arts. Through connections made, Ryan has gone on to write and produce sketch comedy shows, perform in improv groups, and book performances at theaters across Chicago. Now, he’s dedicated to helping others do the same.

Don’t Quit Productions was founded with the mission of guiding creatives from concept to stage. Ryan's goal is to support artists with sketch or show ideas, helping them navigate the business side of show production. Don’t Quit Productions aims to be recognized as a premier name in Chicago comedy, with its stamp on show posters signifying top-tier performances, eventually expanding into film and more.

staff.name: Kitty Clark
staff.bio:
Kitty Clark is a writer, comedian, and Artistic Director of Don't Quit Productions. She began writing and producing her own sketch comedy in Chicago, and her debut show, Puff, Puff, Laugh, earned First Runner-Up for Best Comedy Show of 2024 from the Chicago Reader. She was later shortlisted for SNL UK's inaugural writing team.

As Artistic Director, Kitty has written, produced, or directed every DQP show to date, growing the company from a single sketch show into a full slate of sketch, improv, and variety productions. She sets DQP's creative direction and gives its writers and performers the room and resources to develop bold, original work.
